summary.name: Pool Planner AI
summary.one_liner: Pool Planner AI is a paid web service that takes a phone photo of your backyard and uses AI to render 50 photorealistic pool designs placed into that yard.
use_cases: Previewing what a pool would look like in your own backyard before building
Comparing pool shapes, deck styles and looks side by side
Sharing pool mockups with family or a contractor
Showing homeowners pool designs during a builder sales appointment
Adding a pool visualizer to a pool builder's website
summary.what_it_does: The tool asks the user to upload a photo of their backyard, then uses AI to place 50 pool designs onto that photo, varying shape, deck and style. The base package at $15 one time includes 50 photorealistic HD designs, 5 pool shapes, 4 deck styles, 3 looks, spillover spas and rock waterfalls, delivered to a private online gallery where designs can be shared or downloaded. Optional paid add-ons include night versions of the 50 designs, a feature pack of 25 designs with slides, grottos, fire bowls, swim-up bars and deck jets, and a custom dream pool option with 10 renders and one free revision round. The page also describes a version for pool builders to embed on their websites or use during sales appointments.
notable: Generates 50 AI pool designs from a single phone photo of a backyard
Optional night renders and feature pack add-ons
Builder version for embedding on websites or using in sales appointments
caveats: Gallery stays online for only 30 days
Base price is $15 one-time with optional paid add-ons; no subscription tiers
Custom Dream Pool renders are offered after checkout and the page does not state their price
